senses.gloss:
पर्शान पर्शान, अस्, m. (probably connected
with rts. पर्ष् and पृष्), Ved. a precipice, chasm;
a well; (Sāy.) = पार्श्व-स्थान, the side; = पीड्य-
मान, being oppressed; = स्पृश्यमान; = विमर्-
शन-क्षम; (according to the Naighaṇṭuka I.
10) a cloud.

1. पर्शु, उस्, m., Ved. a rib; a curved knife,
pruning-hook, sickle; N. of a man; (अवस्), m. pl.,
N. of a warrior-tribe; (उस्), f. (according to the
Nirukta IV. 6) the supporting or side wall of a well
(Ṛg-veda I. 105, 8, but according to Sāy. = पार्-
श्वास्थि); N. of a woman.
—पर्शु-मय, अस्, ई,
अम्, shaped like a curved knife.

पर्शु 2. पर्शु, उस्, m. (fr. पृ, substituted
for rt. स्पृश्), = परशु, an axe, hatchet.
—पर्शु-
पाणि, इस्, m. ‘axe in hand, ’ an epithet of Gaṇeśa;
[cf. परशु-धर.]
—पर्शु-राम = परशु-रा-
म, q. v.
पर्शुका, f. a rib.
पार्शुका, f. = पर्शुका, a rib.
पर्श्वध, अस्, m. = परश्वध, an axe, hatchet.

पर्ष् पर्ष् [cf. rts. पृष्, वर्ष्, स्पर्ष्],
cl. 1. A. पर्षते, &c., to grow wet, be-
come moist; to delight in, accept (Sāy. = स्वी-कृ).

पर्ष पर्ष, अस्, m. (probably connected
with rt. पृष्), a bundle, sheaf.

2. पर्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, = परुष, keen, piercing
(said of the wind).

पर्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. in इषु-प्˚, (probably)
carrying bundles (of arrows).

पर्षणि पर्षणि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. rt. 1. पृ),
Ved. carrying over or across, ferrying across.
पर्षन्, अ, n. (?), Ved. leading out, delivering.

पर्षिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. most mighty in
delivering or rescuing.

पर्षद् पर्षद्, त्, f. = परिषद्, an assem-
bly, audience.
—पर्षद्-भीरु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved.
shy in society.
—पर्षद्-वल, अस्, आ, अम्, = परि-
षद्-वल, surrounded by an assembly; (अस्), m. an
assistant at an assembly, a spectator.

पार्षद् पार्षद्, त्, f. (for परि-षद?), an
assembly; (दस्), m. pl. the attendants or retinue of
a god.

पार्शव 1. पार्शव, अस्, m. (fr. 1. पर्शु),
a prince of the Parśus.

पार्शव 2. पार्शव, अस्, m. a warrior armed
with an axe.

पार्श्व, अस्, अम्, m. n. the region of the ribs or
the part of the body below the armpit; the side,
flank (either of animate or inanimate objects); a
side of any square figure; a curved knife (Ved.);
(अस्), m., N. of an ancient Buddhist teacher; (with
Jainas) N. of the twenty-third Arhat of the present
Ava-sarpiṇī; (औ), m. du. heaven and earth; (अम्),
n. a multitude of ribs, the thorax; the extremity of
the fore-axle nearest the wheel to which the outside
horses of a four-horse chariot are attached; a fraudu-
lent or crooked expedient, dishonourable means;
(आनि), n. pl. the ribs (Ved.); (ए), ind. at the side,
near, on, upon, (opposed to दूर-तस्, दूरे);
aside; (अयोस्), ind. on both sides; (आत्), ind. away
from; (अम्), ind. near to, to, towards; (अस्, आ, अम्),
near, proximate, by the side of.
—पार्श्व-ग, अस्,
आ, अम्, going at the side (of any one), accompanying,
being in close proximity to, an attendant; (आस्), m.
pl. attendants, retinue.
—पार्श्व-गत, अस्, आ, अम्,
being at the side, attending, accompanying, being
close to or beside; sheltered, screening.
—पार्श्व-
गमन, अम्, n. the act of going by the side,
accompanying.
—पार्श्व-चर, अस्, m. an attendant;
(आस्), m. pl. attendants, retinue.
—पार्श्व-तस्, ind.
by or from the side, at the side, near, sideways,
aside.
—पार्श्व-द, अस्, m. ‘turning the side towards
another,’ an attendant; (आस्), m. pl. attendants,
retinue.
—पार्श्व-दाह, अस्, m. a burning pain in
the side.
—पार्श्व-देश, अस्, m. the region of the
ribs, the side.
—पार्श्व-द्रुम, आस्, m. pl. the
trees at the side, the trees on every side.
—पार्श्व-
नाथ, अस्, m. (with Jainas) N. of an Arhat; the
Jaina pontiff.
—पार्श्वनाथ-काव्य, अम्, n., N. of
a poem by Padma-sundara celebrating the preceding
Arhat.
—पार्श्व-परिवर्तन, अम्, n. ‘the turning
round on the other side or from one side to the
other,’ epithet of a festival on the eleventh day of the
light half of the month Bhādra (Viṣṇu being sup-
posed to turn upon the other side in his sleep on
this day).
—पार्श्व-परिवर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, being or
going by the side (of any one).
—पार्श्व-पिप्पल,
अम्, n. a species of Harītakī (= Hindī गजहड्).
—पार्श्व-भाग, अस्, m. ‘side-portion,’ the side,
flank (of an elephant).
—पार्श्व-रुज्, क्, f. pain in
the side.
—पार्श्व-वक्त्र, अस्, m. whose face is in
his side,’ N. of a being attendant upon Śiva (Hari-
vaṃśa 14851).
—पार्श्व-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, standing
by the side, an attendant; situated at the side,
adjacent; (इनस्), m. pl. attendants, retinue.
—पार्-
श्व-विवर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, being by the side of, living
with.
—पार्श्व-शय, अस्, आ, अम्, lying or sleeping
on the side; sleeping at the side.
—पार्श्व-शायिन्,
ई, इनी, इ, ‘lying on the side,’ epithet of a particular
position of the moon.
—पार्श्व-शूल, अस्, m. a
shooting pain in the side, spasm of the chest, stitch;
pleurisy.
—पार्श्व-संस्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, lying on
the side.
—पार्श्व-सूत्रक, अस्, or अम्, m. or n. (?),
a kind of ornament.
—पार्श्व-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्,
standing at the side or next to, being near or close
to, adjacent, proximate; (अस्), m. an associate, com-
panion; a stage manager's assistant (said to serve as
a sort of chorus to the Indian drama, being some-
times an actor in the prelude and interpreter of the
plot).
—पार्श्व-स्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, standing at the
side, being near or close to.
—पार्श्वानुचर (˚व-
अन्˚), अस्, m. ‘attending at the side,’ an attendant,
body-servant, lackey.
—पार्श्वायात (˚व-आय्˚), अस्,
आ, अम्, one who has approached close to.
—पार्श्वा-
सन्न (˚व-आस्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, standing by the side,
standing next, present.
—पार्श्वासीन (˚व-आस्˚), अस्,
आ, अम्, sitting by the side.
—पार्श्वास्थि (˚व-अस्˚),
इ, n. ‘side-bone,’ a rib.
—पार्श्वैकादशी (˚व-एक्˚),
f., N. of a particular festival (= पार्श्व-परिवर्-
तन).
—पार्श्वोदर-प्रिय (˚व-उद्˚), अस्, m.
‘fond of (moving) sideways on the belly,’ a crab.
पार्श्व पार्श्व. See p. 569, col. 3.

पार्श्वक, अस्, m. a rib; (अस्, आ, अम्), one who
seeks wealth or other objects by dishonest or indirect
or side means; a pilferer, swindler.

पार्श्वतीय, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. पार्श्व-तस्), being
on or belonging to the side, situated at the side.

पार्श्विक, अस्, ई, अम्, lateral, belonging to the
[]
side; (अस्), m. a sidesman, partisan; an associate,
companion; a juggler; one who seeks money by
dishonest means; N. of an ancient Buddhist teacher.

पार्श्व्य, औ, m. du. heaven and earth (a various
reading for पार्श्वौ).
पार्षकि पार्षकि, इस्, m. a patronymic.

पार्षत पार्षत, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पृषत),
belonging to the spotted antelope, made of the skin
of the spotted antelope; (अस्), m. a patronymic of
Dru-pada and his son Dhṛṣṭa-dyumna; (ई), f. a
patronymic of Draupadī; an epithet of Durgā (in
this sense a wrong reading for पार्वती); N. of
two plants, Boswellia Thurifera; = जीवनी.

पार्षद, अस्, m. (fr. पर्षद्), an associate,
companion, attendant; a train, retinue (especially of
a god); a person present in a congregation or
assembly, a spectator; (perhaps) a councillor, dis-
tinguished personage; (अम्), n. a text-book received
by any particular grammatical school, a N. given to
the Prātiśākhyas; N. of a work on ceremonies.
—पार्षद-ता, f. the office of an attendant (espe-
cially of the attendant of a deity).

पार्षदीय, अस्, आ, अम्, conformable to the
received text-book of any particular grammatical
school.

पार्षद्य, अस्, m. = पारिषद्य, a member of
an assembly or council, assessor; (आस्), m. pl. the
attendants or retinue of a god (especially of Śiva).

पार्षद्वाण पार्षद्वाण, अस्, m. (fr. पृषद्-
वाण), N. of a man.
पार्षिका पार्षिका, f., N. of a woman.
पार्षी पार्षी (?), f. dung.

पार्ष्टेय पार्ष्टेय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पृष्टि),
being within the ribs.

पार्ष्ठिक पार्ष्ठिक, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. being
after the manner of the Pṛṣṭhya (Ṣaḍ-aha).

पार्ष्णि पार्ष्णि, इस्, m. f., rarely पार्ष्णी, f.
(said to be fr. rt. पृष्), the heel; the extremity of
the fore-axle to which the outside horses of a four-
horse chariot are attached (the two inner horses being
harnessed to the धुर् or chariot-pole); the rear of
an army; the back; a kick; enquiry, asking (?);
(इस्), f. a foolish or licentious woman; a N. of
Kuntī the wife of Pāṇḍu.
—पार्ष्णि-क्षेम, अस्,
m., N. of a divinity.
—पार्ष्णि-ग्रह, अस्, आ,
अम्, seizing from behind, threatening from behind;
(अस्), m. a follower.
—पार्ष्णि-ग्रहण, अम्, n.
attacking or threatening (an enemy) in the rear.
—पार्ष्णि-ग्राह, अस्, आ, अम्, attacking or menac-
ing (an enemy) in the rear; (अस्), m. an enemy in
the rear; a commander in the rear of an army;
an ally who supports a prince (Manu VII. 207).
—पार्ष्णि-त्र, अम्, n. ‘rear-protecting,’ a rear-
guard, reserve, a body of forces in the rear.
—पार्ष्-
णि-वाह्, ट्, ऊही, ट्, or पार्ष्णि-वाह, अस्, आ, अम्, draw-
ing (i. e. harnessed to) the extremities of the axle-
tree; (अस्), m. an outside horse.
—पार्ष्णि-सारथि,
इस्, m. a charioteer who drives one of the outside
horses; (ई), m. du. the two charioteers who drive
the outer horses attached to the extremities of the
axle-tree.
